FIELDS.NAME: Golden Crust Bakery
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Golden Crust Bakery operates as a locally-owned bakery and bagel shop dedicated to providing high-quality baked goods made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Our establishment bakes all products on-site, including a variety of bread, pastries, and bagels, while adhering to stringent food safety standards, including ServSafe certification to mitigate foodborne illness risks. We maintain rigorous sanitation and refrigeration controls to ensure the freshness and safety of our products at all times. Additionally, we utilize monitored fire and burglar alarm systems to enhance safety measures and reduce fire and theft exposures. Our hours of operation are tailored to peak breakfast and lunch sales, allowing us to cater to our community effectively. We pride ourselves on our commitment to quality, safety, and exceptional customer service, positioning ourselves as a trusted source for delicious baked goods in Springfield.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 10, 2023, a water pipe burst in the kitchen area, causing damage to the flooring and some equipment. The estimated repair cost was $1,500, and the claim has been settled. Additionally, on December 15, 2022, a minor fire caused by an overheated oven resulted in property damage amounting to $500, which has also been successfully resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, Class B, UL listed for cash and valuables storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored fire and burglar alarm systems in place, along with security cameras covering all entrances and key areas.

Our operations are focused solely on the preparation and sale of fresh bakery items.
